inpost-notify-buyer.title: Choose when the buyer learns about the shipment
inpost-notify-buyer.tourBody: Choose the moment the marketplace shows the buyer "shipped". This setting belongs to this InPost account.
inpost-notify-buyer.tourTitle: When does the buyer learn about the shipment?
inpost-notify-buyer.why: By default the buyer gets "shipped" only after you click "Mark as shipped". In an InPost account you can change that to the moment the label is bought.

packing-owner.title: Say whether another system packs the parcels
packing-owner.tourBody: Tick the box if another system packs the parcels. It only changes what you see in OpenLinker and blocks nothing.
packing-owner.why: When an external system, for example a warehouse one, packs the orders, OpenLinker hides its own "Mark as packed" button for them. By default the button is visible.

shipping-routing.title: Assign carriers in this sales channel
shipping-routing.tourBody: Check who ships each delivery method of this channel. Change what is needed and save the routing.
shipping-routing.tourTitle: Who ships the parcels from this channel?
shipping-routing.why: Shipping routing is set in Mappings, on the Fulfilment tab. Check who ships each delivery method of this channel and save.
